author: Daniel Stone
title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) iPhone Shipments Surged 12% in China; Morgan Stanley
text:
February 16, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) iPhone Shipments Surged 12% in China; Morgan Stanley 
Recently, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) stock rating maintained to “Overweight” by Morgan Stanley’s Katy Huberty with an unchanged $203 price target as Huberty said in a research report, the iPhone shipments in China surged 12% in the most recent quarter, while Android shipments declined 17% over the same time period. 
According to Morgan Stanley’s analyst, the increase in iPhone shipments in China marks as AAPL’s second-largest sequential share gain in China and it remain consistent with prior data readouts. 
Huberty said, iPhone X’s momentum in China is still expected to drive active smartphone market share gains for the company, in spite of the fact that the current iPhone cycle not being the “supercycle” that many expected, 
According to Morgan Stanley, Apple Inc. (AAPL)’s pricing for its iPhone 6 starts at $350; pricing the iPhone 7 at $130 below the iPhone 8 may have created demand for older iPhone models, the analyst said. But local Chinese brands appear to be responding to their market share losses and the competitive environment is likely to intensify in the mid-market category.
